_doc_language: Render language for the daily report and the agent's chat-side run summary. MUST be a code inside the effective whitelist = resources/i18n.json locales ∩ render_report.py STRINGS keys (currently {"en","zh","es","pt","fr","de","ja","ko","it"}). The agent detects the user's input language, resolves it against this whitelist, and writes the resolved code here BEFORE creating the daily cron. Out-of-whitelist user languages (e.g. "ru", "ar", "th") fall back to "en" (= i18n.json defaultLocale); the agent must tell the user once that the report is not yet localized. "auto" is a seed only — never leave it in production, because render_report.py's tail-end safety net would silently downgrade to en without keeping the agent's chat summary in sync. To add a new locale: extend render_report.py STRINGS and i18n.json entries, then the whitelist auto-expands.
_accio_account_id_doc: Optional. Set only if multiple Accio Work accounts exist under ~/.accio/accounts/. Otherwise the scripts auto-detect the single account.

clarity._doc_project_id: Required for the storefront snippet (Clarity script tag). Copy from Clarity → Settings → Overview.
clarity._doc_use_connector: Default true. When true, the daily report and check_health.py read the Data Export API token from the Accio Work Clarity Connector (Sidebar → Capabilities → Plugins → Shopify → Connectors → Microsoft Clarity). Set to false to force the manual token fallback below.
clarity._doc_api_token: Optional fallback. Only used when (a) use_connector is false, or (b) the Clarity Connector is not connected. JWT from Clarity → Settings → Data Export → Generate new API token. Leave null when relying on the Connector.

judgeme._doc: No configuration needed. If the Judge.me Shopify app is installed, its review summary is auto-synced into Shopify shop metafields (namespace 'judgeme') and read through the same Connector as the other Shopify data — no API token required. If the app is not installed, the Reviews section is simply skipped.
